QuestInfo.name: Nemi's Lunchbox Delivery
QuestInfo.0: Find #b#p2041004##k, head of security for Ludibrium, in #b#m220000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: Nemi asked you to take lunch to her father at the toy factory in #b#m220020300##k. Maybe you missed your calling as a delivery person.
QuestInfo.2: I met #b#p2040015##k, who was at the toy factory, and gave him the lunchbox Nemi packed for him, but it looks like he wants to ask me for something...

0.0: This place, Ludibrium, is a floating castle supported by two huge towers. If you want to get down without going splat, you'll have to go down through Eos Tower. Now, if you have that kind of time, there's something you can do for me...

yes.0: Great! It's a simple job. Since I need to protect the Ludibrium Clocktower and can't leave this place, I would you to help Nemi out in my stead. She is the one of the residents in Ludibrium Village.
yes.1: Please take this Packed Lunch to Nemi's father Karl, the taskmaster of the factory. She said he was at #b#m220020300##k in the Ludibrium Clocktower.

no.0: Oh, it's not that hard at all! In fact, it's a very TASTY favor. You're interested now, right?

1.0: Ohh, this is it! The lunchbox from heaven by none other than my daughter! I can't work without this. Great job bringing this here. Thanks to you, I'll be able to concentrate on my work now. Here are some mesos for you.

yes.0: Mmmhmmm, this is how it should be! #p2041005#'s the best, bar none! Oh, by the way, I have been really busy these days with work, and I was hoping someone help me out here. If you have any free time down the road, please drop by.

npc.0: You still haven't delivered the Packed Lunch to Taskmaster Karl? He's at #b#m220020300##k, and probably starving.

item.0: Hey there. Say, you haven't seen a Packed Lunch around here by any chance? I sure was looking forward to it. If only someone would bring it to me...

lost.0: So... you lost the Packed Lunch that I gave you. Or... did you eat it because it smelled so good? In any event, here's a backup lunch that Nemi gave me, just in case. Do NOT lose this one! I'm not giving up my own lunch if you mess up again.
